label: early original-phase input of s/b/l (positions 1-3)
explanation: Fires almost only in the original (input) phase (99% of mass), at early positions t=1..4 (t=1 holds 50% of mass, t=2 32%, t=3 14%; never at t=0, the delimiter, or meaningfully in the copy phase). Token-selective on the current input: s (37% of mass), b (28%), l (19%), then weaker a, d, w, k; essentially silent on other letters and digits. Mostly on the first occurrence of the token. The predicate s/b/l at t=1..3 captures ~82% of activation mass but precision is only ~0.3: whether it fires on a given s/b/l depends on the preceding prefix (strongest after prefixes like 1 z, 1 e, 1 j z), which I could not capture with simple prior-token predicates. Larger at earlier positions and on s/b; does not fire on later original positions (t>=5).
